description:
## 0.0.22-11 (Muthu build)

Built from Muthu1203-abi/Hushgram on HushGram 0.0.22, synced with SysAdminDoc/HushGram up to 634cb4994. For Instagram 457.0.0.55.73.

* Glass sheets follow the sheet's own theme: Reels' menu and comments sheets get dark glass under their white text instead of light glass that hid it.
* The Liquid Glass bar follows Instagram's tab icons: black icons get light glass and white icons dark glass, so the icons stay readable.
* Also in this build: Double tap the top of a reel to share.
